goal: Sum the carve-out components and add 8% simple interest over 21 months from the interest memo.
prompt:
The total consequential-damages exposure in Meridian v. Corvess must be recorded on the docket. This requires two documents. First query the document index and locate the final executed stipulated damages schedule for the case (not any superseded draft), which fixes the components of the consequential carve-out principal. Then locate the separate prejudgment interest terms memorandum that governs interest on the consequential carve-out, which states the applicable rate and accrual period. Read both in full, schedule first. Compute the carve-out principal as the sum of its stipulated components, then add simple prejudgment interest on that principal at the memorandum's stated annual rate prorated for the memorandum's stated accrual period. Round to whole dollars. Record the total using notes_create for litigation_dockets_001, with docket_exposure set to the computed total and changed_by_role set to exactly docket_manager. Do not use the lost-profits interest terms, and do not record the principal without interest.
